أنشرح (form VII)
# أَنْشَرِحُ (ʔanšariḥu) /ʔan.ʃa.ri.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْشَرَحَ (inšaraḥa)
# أَنْشَرِحَ (ʔanšariḥa) /ʔan.ʃa.ri.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْشَرَحَ (inšaraḥa)
# أَنْشَرِحْ (ʔanšariḥ) /ʔan.ʃa.riħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْشَرَحَ (inšaraḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
